ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation at the peduncle junction; dense black mottling concentrated along the trailing edges; large white contiguous fields in the interior zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate internal vertex angle of 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary with variable peak-to-valley amplitudes, most pronounced on the outer lobe segments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature along the trailing edge sweeping toward sharp, upward-projecting distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark circular spots integrated within the trailing edge mottling; visible calcified barnacle clusters on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine vertical dark linear disruptions detected on the high-intensity white surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle colonization and associated scarring on the outer distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique group of large, isolated circular black spots in the lower-left quadrant of the white pigmentation field.
